+    """Smoothly interpolate a hand traced centerline without rounding its endpoints."""

+        p2 = points[i + 1]

+            out.append(0.5 * ((2 * p1) + (-p0 + p2) * t + (2*p0 - 5*p1 + 4*p2 - p3) * t2

+    cum = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(d)]
+    samples = np.arange(0.0, cum[-1], step_px)
+    if len(samples) == 0 or samples[-1] < cum[-1]:
